name: Statement: blue professional
description: One claim per slide: the left column is a blue-ruled list of supporting points; across a hairline, the right column holds the tinted claim box, three small stat cells and a supplement. A plain text page would lose the reading direction of evidence on the left, conclusion on the right.

kicker.hint: chapter label top left, e.g. "01 — Why"; numbered automatically by the scaffold when the slides in the story carry a chapter, otherwise left empty

meta.hint: rounded tag top right: audience, phase or occasion, up to 10 characters, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion; leave empty when not needed

title.hint: the slide's claim in one sentence, up to 2 lines and 26 characters; *keyword* marks an emphasis (blue)

evidence.hint: 3 to 4 supporting points, up to 2 lines each

body.hint: the claim in one sentence, or a quote, up to 3 lines and 50 characters

stat-1.hint: small stat cell: the metric's value is the number, label its caption (up to 8 characters); leave empty when not needed

caption.hint: supplement for the right column, up to 2 lines

title.value: Fix the three that hit delivery; the rest can wait

items: A fifth of pages take over three seconds to load, mostly on mobile
Three in ten forms give no feedback after submit, so users submit again
Monitoring watches the servers, not the time users actually wait
No one owns the fix process; the same issue returns to the backlog three times

body.value: "Not every problem is worth fixing now, but these three hit delivery directly."

caption.value: The other twelve are in the appendix, ranked by impact and cost, for next quarter.
